name: Login Bonus
description: Chooses what the daily login bonus draws from: the online game's rewards for your floor, or your own lists, with each reward as likely as you make it. The bonus itself is handed out by lid-loginbonus.dll (LiD Login Bonus) - see the readme. Set it in Configuration.
author: KSFA

options.label: As online
options.help: Every reward the online game's login calendar gave at your floor tier that arrives as one present, each as likely as the others. The same as the plugin without this mod.

options.label: Your own lists
options.help: Only the rewards on your three lists under "Your own lists", each as often as its weight says.

settings.label: 1-20F
settings.help: Until the 21F elevator stop is open. Starts as the online list: 65 rewards, all weight 1.

settings.label: 21-40F
settings.help: Once the 21F or 31F elevator stop is open. Starts as the online list: 64 rewards, all weight 1.

settings.label: 41F and up
settings.default_label: The online 41F and up list, to change
settings.help: Once the 41F or 51F elevator stop is open. Starts as the online list: 62 rewards, all weight 1.

patches.description: The online game's rewards (no lists of the mod's own)
patches.sql: DELETE FROM master_login_bonus WHERE cond_type IN ('LID_RANDOM', 'LID_RANDOM_O21', 'LID_RANDOM_O41');

patches.description: Your own reward lists for the daily login bonus
